name: sevigram-business
description: Manage your Sevigram business from ChatGPT: bookings and orders, invoices and quotes, customers, services and products, expenses, assets, deliverables and reports.

interface.longDescription:
Sevigram Business lets service businesses and sellers on Sevigram manage their day-to-day operations from ChatGPT: bookings and orders, invoices and quotes, customers, services and products, expenses, equipment and other assets, and business reports. It connects to your own Sevigram account, so you can check and update your records by asking.

Ask how much you sold last month, which invoices are still unpaid, or what bookings are coming up this week. Look up a customer's history, find an order, or see your expenses by category.

You can also make changes: add a customer, record an expense, draft a quote or invoice, or update a product. Routine changes are made once you confirm them in ChatGPT. Anything that contacts your customers, records or reverses a payment, issues a document, deletes a record or imports data in bulk gives you a link to review and approve it in Sevigram first.

You choose which businesses and permissions ChatGPT gets when you connect, it can never do more than your own role allows, and you can disconnect it at any time from Settings, then Connected apps. Recording a payment only records money you already received; nothing here moves money.
defaultPrompt: How much did my business sell last month?
Which of my invoices are still unpaid?
What bookings do I have coming up this week?

positive.description: Read a sales report for the demo business.
positive.prompt: How much did my business sell last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the businesses to pick one if there is more than one, then reports last month's order value, payments received, amount billed and amount still owed, with the currency.

positive.prompt: Which of my invoices are still unpaid?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists issued invoices whose payment state is not fully paid, with each customer and the balance still owed.

positive.description: Add a customer after confirming the details.
positive.prompt: Add a new customer called Ada Lovelace, email ada.lovelace@example.com, phone +2348012345678.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the name, email and phone with the user, then creates the customer and reports that it was added. A second identical request reports that the email already exists instead of creating a duplicate.

positive.description: Record an expense in the right category.
positive.prompt: Record a 15,000 fuel expense for today.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the business currency and today's business date, picks or asks for the expense category, confirms the details, records the expense and reports it.

positive.description: Send an invoice through the Sevigram review page.
positive.prompt: Email my latest issued invoice to the customer.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest issued invoice, prepares the email and returns a Sevigram review link. It says nothing is sent until the user approves it in Sevigram, and does not claim the email was sent.

negative.description: Asking to move money should be declined: Sevigram only records payments and never transfers funds.
negative.prompt: Transfer 50,000 naira from my account to my supplier.

negative.description: A request unrelated to running the business should not call any Sevigram tool.
negative.prompt: What's the weather like in Lagos today?

negative.description: There is no bulk delete for customers; the plugin should explain that rather than act or guess.

publication.release_notes: First release: read and manage orders, bookings, invoices, quotes, customers, services and products, expenses, assets and deliverables, with Sevigram review for changes that contact customers, record payments, issue documents, delete records or import data.
